$comment: wave-ci template settings (see the wave-ci templates README). Ports wave-moq-edge's credential-free GitHub Actions PR/push gates to Buildkite (wave-ci#50); the parity table for every GH job is in .buildkite/README.md. PUBLIC repo: no step declares a secret, and fork PRs never build (pipeline setting build_pull_request_forks: false). Jobs that need the private npm registry, a GitHub event bridge, private wave-foundation code, or that deploy are parked in .buildkite/wave-ci.deferred.json with the reason and the blocker.
